faq.q: Do you load the dumpster for me?
faq.a: No. You load your own dumpster. We drop it off, you fill it on your schedule, and we pick it up and haul it away. The back doors open to make loading easier.
Every rental includes 2 tons. Anything over that is $75 per additional ton.

faq.q: What can't go in the dumpster?
faq.a: Hazardous waste, chemicals or liquids; paints, solvents and oils; asbestos; tires and batteries; propane tanks or other pressurized containers. Concrete, dirt, brick and shingles may need special pricing, so tell us first.
Our rubber-wheel trailers are made to be driveway-safe. As with any heavy delivery, we can't be responsible for surface damage from the dumpster's weight, soft ground or weather.
Not on your own driveway or property. If it will sit on a public street or right-of-way, you'll need to get any required permit.

faq.q: What if I need to cancel?
faq.a: Cancelling within 24 hours of the scheduled delivery may carry a $75 fee.
Yes. We serve both residential and commercial customers.

terms.title: Dumpster Rental Terms & Conditions

sections.title: Rental Period
paragraphs: The standard rental period shall be 3, 5, or 7 days from the date of delivery, as selected by the Customer. Additional rental time will be billed at a rate of $50 per day unless otherwise agreed in writing. Additional days must be scheduled at the time of ordering.

sections.title: Payment Terms
paragraphs: Full payment is due at the time of delivery. Customer agrees that any additional charges, including but not limited to overage fees, damages, or trip charges, will be billed and are due upon receipt.

sections.title: Weight Limit & Overage Charges
paragraphs: Each dumpster rental includes a weight limit of 2 tons. Any weight exceeding this limit will be charged at a rate of $75 per additional ton.

sections.title: Acceptable & Prohibited Materials
paragraphs: Customer agrees to only dispose of non-hazardous solid waste. The following materials are strictly prohibited:
after: Heavy materials such as concrete, dirt, brick, and roofing shingles may require special pricing and must be disclosed prior to delivery.

sections.title: Load Level Requirement
paragraphs: All materials must be loaded evenly and must not exceed the top edge (rim) of the dumpster. Overfilled or improperly loaded dumpsters may be refused for pickup and subject to additional charges.

sections.title: Placement & Site Conditions
paragraphs: Customer is responsible for providing a safe, accessible location for delivery and pickup. This includes:
list: Clear access free of vehicles, debris, or obstacles
after: Cusumano Home Improvements LLC is not responsible for damage to driveways, lawns, or surfaces due to the weight of the dumpster or normal delivery conditions.

sections.title: Permits & Regulations
paragraphs: Customer is responsible for obtaining any required permits if the dumpster is to be placed on a public street or right-of-way and must comply with all local, state, and federal regulations.

sections.title: Damage & Liability
paragraphs: Customer assumes full responsibility for any damage to the dumpster beyond normal wear and tear. Customer also assumes liability for any injuries, damages, or losses arising from use or misuse of the dumpster while on site.

sections.title: Unauthorized Relocation
paragraphs: Dumpster placement is final upon delivery. Customer shall not move or attempt to move the dumpster. Unauthorized relocation may result in additional charges and/or liability for damages.

sections.title: Trip Charges / Dry Runs
paragraphs: If delivery or pickup cannot be completed due to blocked access, unsafe conditions, or customer fault, a trip charge of $75 will apply.

sections.title: Weather & Ground Conditions
paragraphs: Cusumano Home Improvements LLC is not responsible for damage caused by soft ground, sinking, weather conditions, or surface failure during the rental period.

sections.title: Cancellation Policy
paragraphs: Cancellations made within 24 hours of scheduled delivery may be subject to a cancellation fee of $75.

sections.title: Responsibility for Contents
paragraphs: Customer is responsible for all materials placed in the dumpster, including materials disposed of by third parties.

sections.title: Early Pickup / Swap Requests
paragraphs: Customer must provide a minimum of 24 hours notice for early pickup or dumpster swap requests. Additional fees may apply.
